seed: Moving a layer that sits under another keeps it under the whole way. At Next defaults with no flag changed: a red rectangle is drawn, then an ellipse over part of it painted crimson. The rectangle is dragged slowly with the button held, photographed mid-move, and the picture with the button down must be the picture it lands on, under 1% apart. The canvas floats a dragged layer as a picture of its own over a picture of everything else, so a layer that sits under another was drawn over it for the whole of a move and dropped back under on the release; a turn did the same until 2026-10-12. The ellipse on top is then moved the same way as the control. Canvas coordinates are document units.

steps.note: THE TEST: the rectangle under the ellipse moved by hand; with the button down the ellipse still covered it, exactly as it does once it lands
the control: the ellipse on top moved the same way, drawn over the rectangle throughout
